workarounds.symptom: Async generator task retries during early close when finalizer fails
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix retry restart of async generator tasks closed during finalizer failure. Target files: src/prefect/task_engine.py, tests/test_task_engine.py. `run_generator_task_async` calls `gen.throw(exc)` when a consumer closes a generator task, but async generators only have `athrow()`. The resulting `AttributeError: 'async_generator' object has no attribute 'throw'` is raised while the run contexts are still active, so it is handled as a retryable task failure: the task body restarts, and the consumer's `aclose()` ends in `Runtim... (Ref: https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/pull/23739)

workarounds.symptom: ACI worker: start timeout is measured on the ARM LRO poller (30 s cadence) and deletes container groups that are already running
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Detect ACI container start from the container group instead of only the ARM deployment poller. Target files: src/integrations/prefect-azure/prefect_azure/workers/container_instance.py, src/integrations/prefect-azure/tests/test_aci_worker.py. this PR makes the ACI worker detect a started container from the container group itself. Before, the worker used only the ARM deployment poller, so it deleted container groups that were already running. (Ref: https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/pull/23756)

workarounds.symptom: prefect-redis: Publisher silently drops a message published while a flush awaits the dedup check
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(prefect-redis): keep messages published while a publisher flush is in flight. Target files: src/integrations/prefect-redis/prefect_redis/messaging.py, src/integrations/prefect-redis/tests/test_messaging.py. this PR fixes `prefect_redis.messaging.Publisher._publish_current_batch` silently dropping a message that `publish_data` appends while a flush is awaiting `Cache.without_duplicates`. The flush now takes ownership of the batch (`batch, self._batch = self._batch, []`) before its first `await`, and flushes are seriali... (Ref: https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/pull/23792)

workarounds.symptom: `prefect deploy` and `prefect flow serve` report flow script errors as `An exception occurred.`
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Show the script error from `prefect deploy` and `prefect flow serve` for flows that fail to load. Target files: src/prefect/cli/deploy/_commands.py, src/prefect/cli/flow.py, tests/cli/test_deploy.py. this PR makes `prefect deploy` and `prefect flow serve` handle `ScriptError` the way `prefect block register` does: print the script's traceback and exit with the script error, instead of letting it reach `with_cli_exception_handling`, which prints Prefect's own frames and ends with `An exception occurred.`. Follow-up to #23773. (Ref: https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/pull/23807)

workarounds.symptom: git fetch origin <short-sha> fails with exit code 128 in GitRepository._clone_repo
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Skip fetching a pinned commit that the clone already contains. Target files: src/prefect/runner/storage.py, tests/runner/test_storage.py. This PR changes `GitRepository._clone_repo` so that it only runs `git fetch origin <commit_sha>` when the commit is not in the new clone. (Ref: https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/pull/23814)

workarounds.symptom: Worker crashes when reading the deployment fails with a non-404 error before submitting a run
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Keep workers alive when reading the deployment fails before submission. Target files: src/prefect/workers/base.py, tests/workers/test_base_worker.py. this PR stops errors from the pre-submission deployment check in `BaseWorker._submit_run` from crashing the worker, and releases the `--limit` slot when a run is cancelled because its deployment was deleted. (Ref: https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/pull/23836)

workarounds.symptom: Resuming a blocking pause counts as a new run, so a flow with retries that paused once is not retried
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Don't count resuming a blocking pause as a new flow run attempt. Target files: src/prefect/server/orchestration/core_policy.py, src/prefect/server/orchestration/global_policy.py, tests/server/orchestration/api/test_flow_runs.py. this PR makes resuming a blocking pause (`pause_flow_run()` / `wait_for_input` without `reschedule`) continue the current attempt instead of incrementing `run_count`, so a flow with `retries` that paused once is still retried when it fails. (Ref: https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/pull/23839)

workarounds.symptom: Event persister drops a whole batch when one event contains a null byte (PostgreSQL)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Replace null bytes in events before writing them to the database. Target files: src/prefect/server/events/storage/database.py, tests/events/server/storage/test_database.py, tests/events/server/storage/test_event_persister.py. this PR replaces `\x00` with U+FFFD in every string of an event (name, resource and related labels, payload keys and values) in `write_events`. One event with a null byte no longer makes PostgreSQL reject its whole batch, which the persister then dropped after 5 retries. It builds on #23198 by @B1aZe... (Ref: https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/pull/23853)

workarounds.symptom: prefect_sqlalchemy SyncDriver.POSTGRESQL_PSYCOPG2 returns duplicate results on second fetch_many execution
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix SQLAlchemy cursor reuse for parameterized fetches. Target files: src/integrations/prefect-sqlalchemy/prefect_sqlalchemy/database.py, src/integrations/prefect-sqlalchemy/tests/test_cursor_reuse.py. This PR keeps repeated parameterized fetches on the same result cursor in the sync and async SQLAlchemy connectors. (Ref: https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/pull/23847)

workarounds.symptom: `sweep_held_events` deadlocks with multiple triggers replicas
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Skip locked rows when sweeping held events. Target files: src/prefect/server/events/models/automation_held_events.py, tests/events/server/models/test_automation_held_events.py. This PR makes `sweep_held_events` skip held events that another transaction has locked, instead of waiting on them. A later sweep deletes them. (Ref: https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/pull/23757)

workarounds.symptom: visit_collection raises on defaultdict, corrupts Counter, and skips deque/frozenset
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix `visit_collection` for `defaultdict`, `Counter`, `deque`, and `frozenset`. Target files: src/prefect/utilities/collections.py, tests/test_tasks.py, tests/utilities/test_collections.py. this PR fixes how `visit_collection` handles several stdlib containers, so task futures nested in them are resolved and recorded as upstream `task_inputs`. (Ref: https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/pull/23794)

workarounds.symptom: `prefect deploy` hides import errors behind `Could not find object` for non-`def` entrypoints
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Surface import errors when the placeholder flow fallback cannot find a non-`def` entrypoint. Target files: src/prefect/flows.py, tests/test_flows.py. This PR changes `load_flow_from_entrypoint` so that it re-raises the original `ScriptError` when the placeholder flow fallback (`safe_load_flow_from_entrypoint`) raises. Before, the fallback raised `ValueError: Could not find object ...` for entrypoints that are not a top-level `def` or class (for example `etl_daily = etl.with_options(...)`). `prefect deploy` and `Flow.from_... (Ref: https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/pull/23773)

workarounds.symptom: `load_script_as_module` leaves a script that failed to run in `sys.modules`
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Remove a failed script from `sys.modules` in `load_script_as_module`. Target files: src/prefect/utilities/importtools.py, tests/utilities/test_importtools.py. closes https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/issues/23770 (Ref: https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/pull/23772)

workarounds.symptom: Pull step failures are not visible in the Prefect UI when using the workspace resolver
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Log pull step failures to the API in the workspace resolver. Target files: src/prefect/runner/_workspace_resolver.py, tests/runner/test__workspace_resolver.py. closes https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/issues/23782 (Ref: https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/pull/23783)

workarounds.symptom: flow run finishing with state running
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Treat database and connection pool timeouts as client retryable exceptions. Target files: src/prefect/server/api/server.py, tests/server/api/test_server.py, tests/server/orchestration/test_rules.py. This pull request treats database query timeouts (`TimeoutError`), connection pool timeouts (`sqlalchemy.exc.TimeoutError`), and PostgreSQL connection dropouts (`asyncpg.exceptions.PostgresConnectionError`) as client retryable exceptions in `is_client_retryable_exception()`. (Ref: https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/pull/23741)

workarounds.symptom: `POST /flow_runs/{id}/resume` returns 500 when `run_input` contains an integer outside the 64-bit range
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix 500 from flow run resume when run input has an integer beyond 64 bits. Target files: src/prefect/client/schemas/objects.py, src/prefect/input/actions.py, src/prefect/server/api/flow_runs.py. This PR makes `POST /flow_runs/{id}/resume` accept `run_input` that contains an integer outside the 64-bit range. The run resumes, the server stores the exact value, and the SDK loads it back without losing precision. (Ref: https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/pull/23617)

workarounds.symptom: prefect block type inspect crashes with IndexError on an empty description
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix IndexError in `prefect block type inspect`/`ls` on empty description. Target files: src/prefect/cli/block.py, tests/cli/test_block.py. This PR fixes an `IndexError` in `prefect block type inspect` and `prefect block type ls` when a block type has an empty description (`""`). (Ref: https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/pull/23762)

workarounds.symptom: exit_with_error crashes with MarkupError when the message contains a closing bracket tag
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Disable Rich markup by default in `exit_with_error`. Target files: src/prefect/cli/_utilities.py, src/prefect/cli/config.py, src/prefect/cli/deploy/_actions.py. This PR sets `markup=False` as the default in `exit_with_error`. Error messages often contain user input or server error text. Before this change, a closing tag such as `[/x]` caused a `MarkupError` traceback, and the real error was lost. (Ref: https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/pull/23763)

workarounds.symptom: Task parameters that are dataclasses with init=False fields fail to resolve
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Preserve init=False dataclass fields in visit_collection. Target files: src/prefect/utilities/collections.py, tests/test_futures.py, tests/utilities/test_collections.py. This PR fixes `visit_collection` for dataclasses that have `field(init=False)` fields. When anything inside such a dataclass changes, for example a future in a task parameter being resolved, it called `dataclasses.replace()` with every field, which raises `ValueError` for `init=False` fields. The task then fails with "Failed to resolve inputs in parameter... (Ref: https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/pull/23270)

workarounds.symptom: UI v2 crashes with `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'replaceAll')` when the browser reports no time zone
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fall back to UTC when the browser reports no time zone in ui-v2. Target files: ui-v2/src/utils/date.test.ts, ui-v2/src/utils/date.ts, ui-v2/src/utils/index.ts. this PR adds a `getLocalTimezone()` helper to `ui-v2/src/utils/date.ts` that returns `Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone`, or `"UTC"` when that value is missing or reading it throws. `TimezoneSelect` and `SchemaFormInputStringFormatDateTime` now use the helper instead of reading `resolvedOptions().timeZone` directly. (Ref: https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/pull/23738)

workarounds.symptom: Tasks submitted from a sync task inside an async flow can fail with "client has been closed" after the parent task returns
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Keep inherited sync client open for tasks submitted via `ThreadPoolTaskRunner`. Target files: src/prefect/task_runners.py, tests/test_task_runners.py. This PR makes `ThreadPoolTaskRunner.submit` keep the sync client from the submitting context open until the submitted task is done. (Ref: https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/pull/23749)

workarounds.symptom: MemoryLockManager and FileSystemLockManager raise on release_lock after a lock expires; RedisLockManager does not
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Tolerate release of expired locks in MemoryLockManager and FileSystemLockManager. Target files: src/prefect/locking/filesystem.py, src/prefect/locking/memory.py, tests/test_locking.py. - `MemoryLockManager.release_lock` and `FileSystemLockManager.release_lock` now treat a lock that was already released or expired (e.g. its `hold_timeout` elapsed, or it was released during a task retry) as a no-op, matching the documented `RedisLockManager.release_lock` semantics. Releasing a live lock held by a different holder still rais... (Ref: https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/pull/23725)

workarounds.symptom: Pausing or resuming a deployment schedule clears its parameter overrides
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Keep deployment schedule parameter overrides on partial schedule updates. Target files: src/prefect/server/api/deployments.py, src/prefect/server/models/deployments.py, tests/cli/deployment/test_deployment_cli.py. This PR stops partial schedule updates from clearing the parameter overrides of a deployment schedule. For example, `prefect deployment schedule pause/resume` and the schedule toggle in the React UI send only `{"active": ...}`. Before this change, these calls set the schedule's `parameters` to `{}`. (Ref: https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/pull/23719)

workarounds.symptom: Runner calls `on_crashed` hooks by keyword, so a hook that works for `on_failure` fails on crash
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Accept the same flow state hook signatures in the engine and the runner. Target files: src/prefect/_internal/engine.py, src/prefect/flow_engine.py, src/prefect/flows.py. this PR makes flow state hooks get their arguments the same way in the engine and the runner: by name when the hook names its parameters `flow`, `flow_run` (or `run`) and `state`, positionally otherwise. Before, the engine always passed them positionally and the runner always by name, so a hook that worked on failure could fail on crash. (Ref: https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/pull/23715)

workarounds.symptom: Invalid values in request bodies return 503 (retried by the client) or 500 instead of 422
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Return 422 instead of 503/500 for invalid values in request bodies. Target files: src/prefect/server/api/server.py, src/prefect/server/utilities/server.py, tests/server/api/test_server.py. This PR makes the server return 422 for invalid values in request bodies. Before, some of these values gave 503 (which the client retries) or 500. (Ref: https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/pull/23619)

workarounds.symptom: Work queues stay Not Ready for ~5 minutes after Redis recovers, even though workers are polling
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Replace stuck readiness tasks when a poll would mark something ready. Target files: src/prefect/server/api/deployments.py, src/prefect/server/api/work_queues.py, src/prefect/server/api/workers.py. This PR makes a poll that would move a work queue or deployment to `READY` replace any pending readiness task with the same key, instead of being deduplicated against it. (Ref: https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/pull/23644)

workarounds.symptom: Deployment concurrency lease renewal gets 410 after the server applies the terminal state, and crashes a run that completed
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Don't crash completed runs when lease renewal gets 410 after terminal state. Target files: src/prefect/concurrency/_leases.py, src/prefect/flow_engine.py, tests/concurrency/test_leases.py. This PR stops the deployment concurrency lease renewal from cancelling a flow run that is already final on the server. (Ref: https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/pull/23659)

workarounds.symptom: Zombie-detection automation false-positives on healthy completed flows
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Count expect events that race or precede a proactive trigger's window. Target files: src/prefect/events/schemas/automations.py, src/prefect/server/database/_migrations/versions/postgresql/2026_10_19_000000_e7f54680bce3_add_automation_held_event.py, src/prefect/server/database/_migrations/versions/sqlite/2026_10_19_000000_8f5eda7c1dd7_add_automation_held_event.py. A proactive trigger with `after` could fire on a window that an `expect` event had satisfied, so the zombie flow detection automation in #21932 crashed flow runs... (Ref: https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect/pull/23445)
